This is the January 2025 analysis file that produced the published tables, figure and incidence rate ratios [@swaminathan2025hope]. It is kept for comparison: the [differences page](differences.qmd) lists each place where the rebuilt scripts depart from it, and why.

::: callout-note
## Edited for publication
For patient privacy, three lines were changed. The intervention date and the identifier of one corrected record are commented out and replaced by `<removed for patient privacy>`. A file location on the analyst's computer is replaced by `<data folder>/`. The comment above the correction now gives its reason in general terms, "the recipient became ineligible before transplant". The header was also edited: a neutral title, the author's name spelled correctly, and the date of the file. Otherwise the file is unchanged. Because the removed values are needed, it does not run as shown.
:::

It is shown below as it would read when knitted, with its prose formatted, but nothing in it is run. Each code chunk is folded under a header giving its number, its label and options, and its line numbers in the file. Click a header to open that chunk, or use **Show All Code** in the **Code** menu at the top of the page to open them all.
